Passages cover chip and connection checks, but I found no troubleshooting guide for a terminal that has been offline for 5 hours with no signal. These are the steps they do give:

1. Turn the terminal off, open the back cover, and check that the chip is in the SIM1 or SIM2 slot with the metal side facing down [1].
2. Close the cover, turn it on, and wait for the data network to connect. When it shows "connected" (2G or 3G), it is ready to use [1]. The on/off keys depend on your model [5].
3. Run a communication test: press the function button (F, # or the one on your machine), choose option 2 (maintenance), then option 1 (communication test) [1][3].

If it still has no signal, I can propose opening a support ticket with the reason "no signal". It would only be proposed, and nothing runs until you confirm [policy:capabilities].
